body.input: Which companies entered the Norwegian market in 2026?

response.content:
## Companies That Entered the Norwegian Market in 2026

Several notable companies expanded into or established new operations in Norway during 2026:

### Food & Delivery
- **Uber (Uber Eats)** — In February 2026, Uber announced the expansion of its food-delivery business into seven new European markets, including Norway. The company expects the move to generate an additional $1 billion in gross bookings over three years.
- **KFC / Apollo Group** — Apollo Group, in cooperation with MM Group and KFC's franchisor, is acquiring the Norwegian Fly Chicken restaurant chain (19 locations) to bring the KFC franchise to Norway. Apollo Group plans to invest around €20 million in the Norwegian market over the next five years, converting existing Fly Chicken locations into KFC restaurants and opening new ones.

### Technology & Data Centers
- **atNorth** (Iceland-based data center provider) — In June 2026, atNorth announced its expansion into Norway with the acquisition of land for a mega data center site (NOR01) in Haugaland. The 36-hectare site will launch with 120 MW capacity, designed to grow to 350 MW. atNorth also joined the Norwegian Data Center Industry association.
- **CATL (NING SERVICE)** — On 24 September 2026, Chinese battery giant CATL opened its largest NING SERVICE centre outside Asia in Oslo. The 8,000 m² facility serves Norway and the wider Nordic region, providing battery lifecycle services, technician training, and supporting circular economy efforts.

### Maritime & Environmental Services
- **Euro Tech Holdings** (Nasdaq: CLWT) — In October 2026, Euro Tech Holdings entered Norway through a 50/50 joint venture with Sea Clean AS, establishing CleanPACT Environmental and Marine Engineering AS. The venture operates as a customer experience centre for port-based ballast water treatment technology.

### Mining & Resources
- **ACG Metals** (LSE: ACG) — In November 2026, ACG Metals agreed to acquire 100% of Blue Moon Norway AS for US$220 million in shares, including a 94.52% interest in the construction-stage Nussir copper mine and other Norwegian development interests.

### Offshore Drilling
- **Noble Corporation** — Noble Corporation secured a three-year, US$473 million harsh-environment semisubmersible contract for Noble GreatWhite offshore Norway, marking a significant entry into the Norwegian offshore drilling market.

### Notable Exit
- **Johnson & Johnson** — Conversely, J&J announced it is pulling its commercial pharmaceutical operations from Norway after reviewing the country's environment for innovative medicines.

context.content: # Apollo Group will expand to the Norwegian market with the KFC franchise. Apollo Group, in cooperation with MM Group and KFC franchisor, is in the process of acquiring the local Fly Chicken restaurant chain operating in the Norwegian market in order to bring the KFC franchise to the Norwegian market. Today, Fly Chicken operates 19 locations in Norway, most of which Apollo Group plans to convert into KFC restaurants. In addition, Apollo Group plans to open new KFC restaurants in Norway within the next 5 years. Together with the acquisition of the company, Apollo Group plans to invest around 20 million euros in the Norwegian market over the next 5 years. Following completion, Fly Chicken's co-founder and CEO Ronny Gjøse, a hands-on restaurant operator with more than 35 years in the industry, will continue as CEO and lead the transition, conversion and further development of the business in Norway.

document.name: Apollo Group will expand to the Norwegian market with the KFC franchise

context.content: # atNorth Expands to Norway with New Mega Site in Haugaland. *The new mega site will launch with an initial capacity of 120MW and is designed to grow to 350MW to meet future demand.*. HAUGALAND, Norway, June 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- atNorth, the leading Nordic high-density colocation and built-to-suit data center provider, has announced its expansion into Norway with the acquisition of land for a mega data center site in Haugaland. The 36-hectare plot within Haugaland Business Park, will be the location for atNorth's new planned data center, NOR01. "Expanding to Norway has been a long-term strategic priority for us, and we're proud to officially mark our presence across all the Nordic countries with the announcement of NOR01," said Eyjólfur Magnús Kristinsson, CEO of atNorth. The announcement of NOR01 follows atNorth's announcement of a future mega site, SWE04, in Sollefteå, Sweden, in addition to metro sites in Sweden and Finland and also the expansion of two of its data centers in Iceland.

document.name: atNorth Expands to Norway with New Mega Site in Haugaland

context.content: REYKJAVÍK, Iceland, June 9, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- atNorth, the leading Nordic high-density colocation and built-to-suit data center provider, today announced that it has joined the Norwegian Data Center Industry, an industry body representing the whole data center ecosystem in Norway. The announcement follows atNorth's recent expansion into Norway, marked by the acquisition of land for its flagship NOR01 data center campus at Haugaland Business Park, a 36-hectare site designed to support high-density workloads and hyperscale deployments. By joining the Norwegian Data Center Industry, atNorth aims to bolster collaboration between industry stakeholders, policymakers, and regional partners to support the continued growth of Norway's digital infrastructure ecosystem. The business is also a participant in global initiatives including theClimate Neutral Data Centre Pact and the UN Global Compact, as well as being an active member of the European Data Center Association (EUDCA) and other regional data center industry associations in the Nordics.

document.name: atNorth Joins Norwegian Data Center Industry (Norsk Datasenterindustri) Following Strategic Expansion into Norway

context.content: # Europe's Largest NING SERVICE Experience Center Opens in Norway. 25, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On 24 September 2026, CATL opened its largest NING SERVICE centre outside Asia in Oslo, extending its battery lifecycle service network in Europe. The 8,000 square metre centre will serve Norway and the wider Nordic region, providing battery services, training local technicians and supporting circular economy efforts across the region. The Norway Centre is built to meet it. In line with its vision, NING SERVICE is building an aftermarket ecosystem that keeps batteries in use for longer and returns their materials into new batteries. The Norway Centre will be a key hub in NING SERVICE's European network, bringing high-quality service closer to customers in line with its promise to be "Your Nearby New Energy Service Expert.". Combined with YES-EU's local knowledge and service capabilities, we can build a stronger battery service ecosystem across the Nordics and support the long-term growth of Europe's EV market," said Benedikt G.

document.name: Europe's Largest NING SERVICE Experience Center Opens in Norway

context.content: # Euro Tech Holdings Company Limited Announces The Company has signed a 50/50 Joint Venture Agreement With Sea Clean AS In Norway. HONG KONG, Oct. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Euro Tech Holdings Company Limited (Nasdaq: CLWT) today announces its entry into Norway through a 50/50 joint venture ("JV") agreement signed between Sea Clean AS ("Sea Clean") and its wholly owned subsidiary, Euro Tech Global Pte Ltd. CleanPACT Environmental and Marine Engineering AS ("CleanPACT") is the name of the JV company. CleanPACT will serve as a Customer Experience Center for port ballast water treatment, offering customers hands-on demonstrations, expert servicing, realistic simulations, and tailored training with the Company's next-generation mobile hybrid system (PortoBallast is the trade mark of the system) designed to treat ballast water from UV and electrolysis type ballast water treatment systems that do not meet discharge compliance requirements aboard vessels. Sea Clean is a Norwegian provider of ballast water treatment solutions for the maritime industry.

document.name: Euro Tech Holdings Company Limited Announces The Company has signed a 50/50 Joint Venture Agreement With Sea Clean AS In Norway

context.content: # Euro Tech Holdings Signs 50/50 Norway Joint Venture to Expand Ballast Water Treatment Business. Euro Tech Holdings has established a joint venture with Sea Clean AS to introduce its PortoBallast technology in Norway, creating a platform for potential expansion across Scandinavia and the wider European maritime market. * Euro Tech Holdings (NASDAQ:CLWT) has signed a 50/50 joint venture agreement with Norway-based Sea Clean AS, establishing CleanPACT Environmental and Marine Engineering AS. Euro Tech Holdings (NASDAQ:CLWT) announced that its wholly owned subsidiary, Euro Tech Global Pte Ltd., has entered into a 50/50 joint venture agreement with Norwegian maritime services provider Sea Clean AS. The newly established company, CleanPACT Environmental and Marine Engineering AS, will operate as a customer experience centre for port-based ballast water treatment technology. The joint venture represents a geographic expansion for Euro Tech, establishing a direct operational presence in Norway and a potential route into Europe's maritime environmental services market.

document.name: Euro Tech Holdings Signs 50/50 Norway Joint Venture to Expand Ballast Water Treatment Business

context.content: # ACG to Acquire 100% of Blue Moon Norway, Including the Construction-Stage Nussir Copper Mine, to Create a High-Growth European Copper Company. LONDON, Nov. 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ACG Metals Limited (LSE:ACG) (LSE:ACGW) has agreed to acquire 100% of Blue Moon Norway AS ("Blue Moon Norway") from Blue Moon Metals Inc. ("Blue Moon"), including its 94.52% interest in the construction-stage Nussir copper mine and other Norwegian development interests, for US$220 million in shares (the "Acquisition"). The Acquisition combines two long-life assets serving European and other Western supply chains: Gediktepe in Türkiye, targeting full-capacity production in 2027, and Nussir, under construction and targeting first copper concentrate in H1 2028. Figures include 100% of Nussir; ACG would own 94.52% at completion and expects to consolidate its interest to 100% within 12 months. * **High-margin cash-flow growth:** Nussir is expected to contribute cash flow from 2028 as Gediktepe completes its ramp-up and growth projects, with both assets expected to deliver sector-leading free cash flow margins.

document.name: ACG to Acquire 100% of Blue Moon Norway, Including the Construction-Stage Nussir Copper Mine, to Create a High-Growth European Copper Company

context.content: # Will New Multi‑Year Offshore Backlog and Norway Entry Reshape Noble's (NE) Competitive Narrative? * Noble Corporation plc recently announced new offshore drilling contract awards for nine rigs, adding approximately US$1.30 billion in backlog, highlighted by a three-year, US$473 million harsh-environment semisubmersible deal for Noble GreatWhite offshore Norway and expanded work across Nigeria, Guyana, the U.S. Gulf, South America, and Trinidad. * We'll now look at how this expanded multi-year backlog, anchored by Noble GreatWhite's Norway campaign, shapes Noble's broader investment narrative. To own Noble today, you have to be comfortable with a cyclical offshore driller that is trying to turn a lumpy earnings profile into a steadier cash story. The new US$1.30 billion of multi‑year backlog, anchored by Noble GreatWhite's Norway contract, directly feeds into that debate by improving long term visibility but also lifting capital needs by about US$210 million through 2026.

document.name: Will New Multi‑Year Offshore Backlog and Norway Entry Reshape Noble's (NE) Competitive Narrative?
